say:2:1521828001:1.text: Master Bakis, why did you ask me to come here?
say:2:1521828001:1.source_cn: 比博老师，为什么要让我来这里？

say:3:1521828002:0.text: My lord, from here, you can see the entirety of Halia.
say:3:1521828002:0.source_cn: 殿下，从这里往西方望，能看见整座呼临城。

say:4:1521828003:1.text: Perseus once told me if he fell in battle, to <style="highlight">bury him right here</style>... so he could keep watching over Halia, even in death.
say:4:1521828003:1.source_cn: 珀尔修斯曾对我说过，如果他不幸战死，就<style=h...

say:7:1521828005:1.text: You?! <style="stress"><player_name></style>! You damn mages from the Arcane Council! How dare you show your face in Halia?!
say:7:1521828005:1.male: You?! <style="stress"><player_name></style>! You damn mages from the Arcane Council! How dare you show your face in Halia?!
say:7:1521828005:1.female: You?! <style="stress"><player_name></style>! You damn mages from the Arcane Council! How dare you show your face in Halia?!

say:8:1521828006:0.text: You, Merlin, and that corpse-defiling loon! Your flood nearly drowned the whole city! And you have the nerve to come back?
say:8:1521828006:0.source_cn: 你和梅林和那亵渎尸体之人引发的洪水几乎吞没了整座呼临城...
say:8:1521828006:0.male: You, Merlin, and that corpse-defiling loon! Your flood nearly drowned the whole city! And you have the nerve to come back?
say:8:1521828006:0.female: You, Merlin, and that corpse-defiling loon! Your flood nearly drowned the whole city! And you have the nerve to come back?

narration:10:1521828008:1.text: Abundius steps in, cutting off Bakis mid-rage, and launches into a careful explanation of your actions.
narration:10:1521828008:1.male: Abundius steps in, cutting off Bakis mid-rage, and launches into a careful explanation of your actions.
narration:10:1521828008:1.female: Abundius steps in, cutting off Bakis mid-rage, and launches into a careful explanation of your actions.

narration:11:1521828009:0.text: With every word, the fire in Bakis' eyes dims, his clenched fists loosening as understanding takes hold.
narration:11:1521828009:0.source_cn: 随着阿邦德陈述，比博脸上的怒意渐渐消退了

say:13:1521828011:1.text: As Regulus of Halia, I will trust your judgment.
say:13:1521828011:1.source_cn: 阿邦德殿下，你是呼临城的领主，我相信你的判断。

say:14:1521828012:0.text: ... I asked you here because I have a request, my lord.

say:15:1521828013:0.text: As you know, many of my students followed Perseus into battle. Many of them never came home. They now rest on those battlefields forever.
say:15:1521828013:0.source_cn: 你知道，我有许多学生都追随珀尔修斯进入了军队，他们之中...

say:16:1521828014:0.text: I've brought some of their belongings. Please allow them to be buried with their beloved commander. Let them watch over Halia together as they once did in life.
say:16:1521828014:0.source_cn: 我带来了他们的一些遗物，请允许他们与敬爱的统帅一起守护...

say:17:1521828015:0.text: I have no problems with that, Master Bakis.

say:19:1521828016:0.text: Also, since Perseus is to be laid to rest here, we should decorate the surroundings a bit.
say:19:1521828016:0.source_cn: 不过，既然珀尔修斯要安葬在这里，还是要把周围装饰一番吧……

say:20:1521828017:1.text: We can place his spear here and decorate it with <style="highlight">flowers and stones</style>. What do you two think?
say:20:1521828017:1.source_cn: 让他的长枪矗立在这里，再用<style=highlig...

choice_prompt:21:1521828017.text: We can place his spear here and decorate it with <style="highlight">flowers and stones</style>. What do you two think?
choice_prompt:21:1521828017.source_cn: 让他的长枪矗立在这里，再用<style=highlight>花草和石头</style>来装饰……怎么样？

say:22:1521828018:0.text: Yes, I want to decorate this place myself.
say:22:1521828018:0.source_cn: 嗯，我准备亲手布置这里。

say:23:1521828019:0.text: Perseus gave his life for Halia. The least I can do... the very least... is make sure everyone remembers.
say:23:1521828019:0.source_cn: 珀尔修斯是为呼临城献出了生命。身为领主，我必须要让他得...

say:24:1521828020:1.text: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, you're a mage, so you must know everything. Come with me and tell me what can be used for decorations.
say:24:1521828020:1.male: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, you're a mage, so you must know everything. Come with me and tell me what can be used for decorations.
say:24:1521828020:1.female: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, you're a mage, so you must know everything. Come with me and tell me what can be used for decorations.

choice:21:2:3.source_cn: 他值得一场盛大的葬礼
